data.name: Abasaheb Sangale
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Abasaheb Sangale has made a big mark in cricket. With 10 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 9, with an average of 6.13 and a quick strike rate of 80.33. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 4 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 36.0 overs, taking 11 wickets at an economy rate of 10.61. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
